# Repository Discovery

Inspect repository roots/status/rules/document map, source entry points and ownership, startup/lifecycle, configuration, data/storage, dependencies, tests, build/CI and relevant platform/service integrations. Verify documented claims against implementation and configuration. Classify facts, assumptions, planned outcomes and validation gaps explicitly.

Protect unrelated changes, serialized identities, generated output and secrets. Exclude dependency caches, build output and private data from portable metadata. Read only task-relevant source during intake; deep research belongs to processing/documentation audit.
